{{Quote|All that work for nothing, pathetic Jedi. You will not survive this.|EG-07|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes">''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Republic Heroes]]''</ref>}}
'''EG-07''' was an [[EG-5 Jedi Hunter droid|EG droid]] purchased by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] in order to be used for covert operations during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. On [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]], he was in battle with [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], ensured that EG-07 was destroyed.

==Biography==
[[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] purchased an expensive [[EG-5 Jedi Hunter droid|EG droid]], EG-07, which he used for secret operations beyond the knowledge of the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Army]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Grievous had learned about a powerful ancient [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]] capable of releasing a deadly virus, which was located somewhere on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]]. With EG-07's help, Grievous planned to rebel against [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and conquer [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] himself. To this end, he [[Mission to Mustafar (superweapon)|dispatched EG-07 to find the weapon]], and the latter located it beneath an ocean of lava, where it was hidden by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]]. EG-07 reported to Grievous on the progress of his mission, but their transmission was intercepted by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on [[Skytop Station/Legends|Skytop Station]], however this transmission did not reveal the name of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] Grievous and his droid talked about. After R2-D2 was rescued, the Jedi learned of Grievous's plans, while the General was forced to use his own spare parts to repair EG-07, which had suffered serious damage during its mission on Mustafar.

As Grievous drilled to the core of the planet to uncover the superweapon and placed a [[Battlesphere/Legends|battlesphere]] similar to Skytop Station above Mustafar, the Jedi started their investigation. They first dispatched [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] to steal Separatist recognition codes from an archive in Grievous's castle on [[Vassek/Legends|Vassek's]] third [[Moon/Legends|moon]], which Grievous left after his encounter with [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]]. Using the stolen codes, the Jedi infiltrated the Separatist-controlled [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Juma 9]] and used the station's scanners to locate the superweapon on Mustafar. Meanwhile, Grievous had found the weapon and prepared to use the battlestation's superlasers to charge the weapon, so that it could fire and spread the deadly virus which would have destroyed all life in the [[Star system/Legends|system]]. Having learned of Grievous's intentions, the Jedi dispatched [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]], Fisto and Commander [[Cody/Legends|Cody]] to prevent the battlestation's lasers from charging the weapon. However, the strike team was delayed by EG-07 long enough for Grievous's plans to come to fruition.
